tests.name: System Owner/User Discovery
tests.description:
Identify System owner or users on an endpoint.

Upon successful execution, cmd.exe will spawn multiple commands against a target host to identify usernames. Output will be via stdout. 
Additionally, two files will be written to disk - computers.txt and usernames.txt.

tests.name: System Owner/User Discovery
tests.description:
Identify System owner or users on an endpoint

Upon successful execution, sh will stdout list of usernames.

tests.name: Find computers where user has session - Stealth mode (PowerView)
tests.description: Find existing user session on other computers. Upon execution, information about any sessions discovered will be displayed.

tests.name: User Discovery With Env Vars PowerShell Script
tests.description: Use the PowerShell environment variables to identify the current logged user.

tests.name: GetCurrent User with PowerShell Script
tests.description: Use the PowerShell "GetCurrent" method of the WindowsIdentity .NET class to identify the logged user.

tests.name: System Discovery - SocGholish whoami
tests.description:
SocGholish performs whoami discovery commands and outputs the results to a tmp file. 
The test will generate a filename similar to the random one generated during execution and write the file to AppData\Temp.

Reference: https://redcanary.com/threat-detection-report/threats/socgholish/

tests.name: System Owner/User Discovery Using Command Prompt
tests.description: Identify the system owner or current user using native Windows command prompt utilities.

tests.name: User Discovery - whoami
tests.description:
Identify the current user account and security context using whoami. Adversaries use this command during initial
reconnaissance after gaining access to a system to determine the user and privilege level they are operating under.
